notices: To update from the app, add the new updater service from docker-compose.yml once, then run docker compose up -d.

items: Update Nanahoshi from Settings › Updates. Admins see when a new release is out, read its notes, and choose Update now or Update when idle.
Update when idle waits until no scan, audiobook stream or backup is running, and everyone sees the planned restart with the option for an admin to cancel it.
After an update, this window shows what changed. Open it again from Settings › About.
The database is backed up automatically before an update changes it. The backup appears in Settings › Data & Backups.
If the server can't start, it shows a page that says why instead of restarting over and over.
Open pages offer a reload once the server runs a newer release.
